title: Why Back Pain Tops Every Other Disability
hook: Back pain disables more people than anything else.
closing: Much of this pain is preventable, so stand up, move, and give your back a break.
question: How's your back right now?

segments.say: Around 619 million people live with chronic back pain. Experts expect it to grow by more than a third, so it keeps getting bigger.
Nearly four in ten cases of back pain trace to things you can change, like weight, smoking and work setup. Fixable.
Back pain cases among working-age adults are up by more than half in about thirty years. It's hitting people when they're working hardest.
